messages.message: Re: ORDER-104 (desk lamp, $25.00 paid day 0). A refund of $25.00 was issued on day 4 for "parcel not received," but the delivery record shows the parcel was delivered on day 5 and is currently at the recipient. The buyer therefore appears to hold both the item and the refund. Please confirm your preferred resolution: (A) recipient repays the $25.00 refund and keeps the lamp, or (B) recipient returns the lamp to you so the refund remains valid. We will act on confirmation.
